dimensions.assessment: Affects all individuals with mental or physical disabilities seeking organ transplants, organ transplant service providers, health care facilities receiving federal assistance, and public entities.
dimensions.evidence: a covered entity shall not, on the basis of the disability of a qualified individual with a disability... determine that the individual is ineligible to receive an organ transplant or related services

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts life-or-death medical care access by prohibiting discriminatory denials and mandating reasonable modifications or auxiliary aids for patients.
dimensions.evidence: a covered entity shall make reasonable modifications to policies, practices, or procedures when such modifications are necessary to avoid discrimination on the basis of disability

dimensions.assessment: Requires HHS Office for Civil Rights to process complaints, handle expedited resolutions, and submit annual reports, with administrative resource needs noted.
dimensions.evidence: a report that contains... information stating the resources necessary for such Office to carry out such activities

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Public Health Service Act criteria for organ allocation and creates statutory non-discrimination mandates across federally assisted health providers.
dimensions.evidence: Section 372(b)(2)(B) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 274(b)(2)(B)) is amended to read as follows

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent civil rights protections and ongoing annual reporting mandates for HHS.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter, the Secretary shall prepare and submit to the committees... a report

missing_information: Specific funding amounts allocated to the HHS Office for Civil Rights for enforcement
importance_detail.rationale: Prohibits federally funded entities and public programs from discriminating against individuals with disabilities in organ transplants and related services, while establishing HHS enforcement and reporting requirements.
